description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 6610007039550 WHEEL ASSY,CROWN: Line 0001 Qty 11 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0062 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
